threshold_source: fixed 0.5; train_model.py selects it on validation after retrain
metrics_note: balanced_accuracy = (recall + specificity) / 2 and is recomputed from the shipped confusion matrices. The old 'roc_auc' field held this same number (0.9231 test) and was mislabelled: it is NOT the area under the ROC curve. roc_auc, pr_auc and brier are null because the trained artifacts saved only binary predictions and the dataset split is not in this repository; they are populated the next time src/models/train_model.py runs.
